item.name: Ampersand Get Object Metadata via Installation

request.name: Ampersand Get Object Metadata via Installation

description.content: Retrieves metadata about an object in a customer's SaaS instance, including its fields. An installation must exist for the given `groupRef` and `integrationId`. The `objectName` can be either the mapped name from your integration config or the native provider name. For Salesforce, nested fields may be included using JSONPath bracket notation (e.g. `$['billingaddress']['city']`).

query.description: (Required) The ID of the user group that has access to this installation.
Excludes fields where `ReadOnly` is `true` from the response.

variable.description: (Required) The Ampersand project ID or project name.
(Required) The unique identifier of the integration.
(Required) The name of the object to retrieve metadata for. You can use either the mapped name from your integration config (e.g. `people`) or the native provider object name (e.g. `contact`).

response.name: The retrieved object metadata.

item.name: Ampersand Get Object Metadata via Connection

request.name: Ampersand Get Object Metadata via Connection

description.content: Retrieves metadata about an object in a customer's SaaS instance, including its fields. A connection must exist for the given `groupRef` and `provider`. For Salesforce, nested fields may be included using JSONPath bracket notation (e.g. `$['billingaddress']['city']`).

query.description: (Required) The ID of the user group whose connection should be used to fetch the metadata.
Excludes fields where `ReadOnly` is `true` from the response.

variable.description: (Required) The Ampersand project ID or project name.
(Required) The provider name (e.g. `salesforce`, `hubspot`).
(Required) The native provider object name to retrieve metadata for.

response.name: The retrieved object metadata.
